definition: a soft, warm fabric used to make jackets and other clothing

definition: thin, weak, and easily broken because it is poorly made

definition: to struggle or have serious trouble making progress

definition: the traditional stories, beliefs, and customs of a community

definition: a short attempt to become involved in a new activity or area

definition: appearing sad and lonely, often because of being left alone

definition: covered with a thin layer of gold or gold-colored material

definition: tight-fitting protective glasses worn over the eyes

definition: a small, compact particle of a substance

definition: to improve or perfect a skill over a period of time

definition: extremely unpleasant, shocking, or bad

definition: a direct telephone line set up for help or information

definition: peculiar to one person; distinctive and unusual

definition: peaceful, beautiful, and almost perfectly pleasant

definition: something that makes progress or movement difficult

definition: relating to Impressionism, an art style capturing light and mood

definition: to put someone in prison or keep them locked up
